text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...! ...Alright, just a 
little more until today's quota—

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Hey, look at this, a Tomachop-san strap!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (—! Tomachop-san?!)

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I found out about him from Tarumae-chan's 
intro! He was super cute, so I just had to 
buy one!

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, for real? So cuuute~! Let's wear 
this to Tarumae-chan's next live!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wahh~...! I'm so glad I promoted 
Tomachop-san...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(That means... word about Tomakomai is 
spreading bit by bit, right? Great, in 
that case—!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Promote Tomakomai together with all the 
fans!" Now is the time to launch this 
project! I'll start researching past case 
studies right away...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Local PR with fan-submitted mascot 
suits"... I see, promoting through 
characters really is crucial...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Why not turn all the local specialties 
into mascot suits? Surf clams, swans, 
haskap berries... And then walk alongside 
Tomachop-san.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There was a PR campaign where mascots 
paraded through town! With help from the 
fans, we might be able to fill the whole 
city with Tomakomai—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
............What the hell are you babblin' 
about?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Espo-san! Perfect timing... Would you 
mind hearing me out?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Nah, that's a straight-up awful idea. 
Filling the streets with mascot suits 
would just get in everyone's damn way.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I see... An indoor event then. If we want 
to draw attention to the mascots, we could 
have them walk a runway—!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hey. Are you for real right now? 
Some weird switch got flipped in your 
head, didn't it?! Cool your jets for a 
second!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
But mascot suits pack an immense 
promotional punch! —At this point, I could 
even wear one myself! If I sing and run in 
a mascot suit, the novelty—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I told you to calm the hell down!! And 
don't run in a mascot suit! You're gonna 
faceplant for sure!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Good grief...! Besides, ain't you done 
plenty of PR already? You don't need to do 
crazy weird stunts now—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's not true. Now that our PR 
activities are finally getting on track, 
we can't afford to let our guard down.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
For the further development of 
Tomakomai... I have to do everything 
within my power!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(Tch... This girl just won't stop! Comin' 
up with all sorts of nonsensical stuff...)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(Her brain is definitely fried! She's 
overworking herself way too hard. What am 
I gonna do with her...)

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Freshly made chocolate carrots, right 
here! Have something sweet to fuel your 
studies~!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —! ............Give one to her—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, no way in hell! Why the heck 
should *I* buy her a snack! Whoa there, 
close one, sheesh—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Eat this, ya damn fool!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san, what is this...? Why are you 
giving this to me?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
T-To make you help me out! Chomping on a 
stick looks cool, alright?! ...Hurry up, 
eat it and hand over the skewer!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...? But—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Quit your whining and just eat it already!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
They say sweet stuff gives your brain a 
break, don't they?! Eat it, and then go 
home! Go to sleep!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A break for my brain...? ...Um, Espo-san, 
could it be that you—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah?! Wh... M-My brain is already sharp as 
hell! What're you lookin' at, punk... You 
lookin' down on me, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Fufu! Well then, I'll happily dig in!

Hokko Tarumae brainstorming Tomakomai's PR 
project, and Espoir City bringing her a 
snack. I watched the scene unfold from a 
nearby seat.
choice_data_list:
She's so earnest... all for the sake of 
her hometown.

Bringing a carrot snack... she's quite 
thoughtful.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah... S-Sorry for being so loud! Did you 
hear what we were saying just now?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! I plan on reading through all these 
materials today!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Gah?! ALL of 'em?! Hey, after I went 
through the trouble of...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Gaaahhhhh! Fine, do whatever you want! 
Hurry up, read 'em, and eat your damn 
carrot already!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—! You... You got some nerve eavesdropping 
on us, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wah wah, Espo-san, please don't be mad! 
The carrot was delicious! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I feel like I can work even 
harder! I'm going to read through every 
single document on my desk today!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Wha...!? ...Haaah... Why's it always gotta 
be like this...?
